Preferred net cash is +53.168B against code's -10.923B. Quantified with code's formula at the final WACC of 10.7%: code target $182 (-13.2%); (i) debt securities only: target $183 (-12.7%); (ii) debt plus haircut equity: target $184 (-12.2%); both at full value: $185 (-11.8%). All Underperform. Needs a controller/code mechanism (e.g. a net-cash adjustment input or filing-text balance-sheet lines) to fix the published figure; alternatively, a controller-recorded decision accepting the understatement. The wacc rationale now gives the Neutral thresholds. The target rounds to $189 or more (upside above -10%) at WACC of about 10.19% or lower on code net cash, 10.29% with debt securities, 10.37% with debt plus haircut equity and 10.41% with both at full value. The base is 33-51bp above these thresholds.

notes: Inputs changed from round 1: WACC 0.105 -> 0.107 only. For the writer, in plain terms: (1) Including marketable debt securities only: target about $183, upside about -12.7%, 2.7pp below the -10% band edge. (2) Including debt securities plus equity securities at a 30% haircut (our preferred view): target about $184, upside about -12.2%, 2.2pp from the band. (4) The rating would turn Neutral at a WACC of about 10.2% on code's net cash, about 10.3% with debt securities and about 10.4% with debt plus haircut equity, roughly 30-50bp below our 10.7%. For the controller: (a) asm-001 needs a mechanism for filing-text balance-sheet items; code's net_cash (-10.923B) understates our preferred +53.168B by about $2.6 per share in both legs, or about $2 in target price.
